findings.location: cmd/blendctl/main.go:cmdCompile vs cmdApply shot nesting; Phase 8 CONTEXT Outputs
findings.bug: Phase 8 required `--out DIR --shot ID` to nest under `DIR/<shot>/` and always use distinct job dirs. preview/render do both via shot join + JobDir/MkdirTemp; compile writes straight into `--out` with no shot nest and no unique job dir.
findings.predicted: Concurrent `blendctl compile … --shot intro|outro --out SAME_DIR` (multi-agent / parallel CI) overwrite each other's script/data/source_map/dependencies.json; SHOT-02 isolation holds only for preview/render paths covered by tests.
findings.fix_hint: Make compile apply the same `filepath.Join(out, shot)` nesting as cmdApply, or always write under a MkdirTemp job dir like RunApply.

findings.bug: SHOT-02 / comment claim hashes from the load snapshot, but BuildDependencyManifest re-ReadFiles disk paths in r.Files after resolve (and after Blender in cmdApply). Loaded module bytes are not retained on Resolved.
findings.predicted: While concurrent shot jobs run, an edit to a shared module yields dependencies.json digests that disagree with Decl/ResolvedDataSHA actually compiled and rendered—false provenance under concurrent agents.
findings.fix_hint: Hash the bytes retained at load time (store digests or raw snapshots on Resolved) and never re-read project inputs when writing dependencies.json.

findings.bug: Plan/ARCHITECTURE treat a shared module as immutable input during a run; execution only documents agent ownership. loadOne sequentially ReadFiles each closure member with no FS snapshot/copy into the job tree.
findings.predicted: Concurrent agents editing shared.module.json (or sibling modules) mid-resolve produce torn Decl across shots, or one shot sees pre-edit bytes and another post-edit while both claim success.
findings.fix_hint: Copy or mmap a consistent closure snapshot into the job dir before resolve/compile, or fail the run if file mtimes/hashes change between first read and manifest write.

findings.bug: Containment uses Lstat+EvalSymlinks on `real` but returns unverified `abs`; readBounded later opens `abs`. No O_NOFOLLOW/openat of the checked real path.
findings.predicted: Concurrent replacement of a module path with an escaping symlink between check and read bypasses PROJ_PATH_ESCAPE and loads out-of-tree bytes into the resolved scene.
findings.fix_hint: Open/read the EvalSymlinks-validated real path (or O_NOFOLLOW) and refuse if the opened file identity diverges from the containment check.

findings.bug: Concurrent isolation relies on unique job dirs and --factory-startup, but Run inherits process env (shared Blender/XDG caches) and uses CommandContext without Setpgid/process-group kill.
findings.predicted: Timeout/cancel of one job can leave Blender child writers racing into that job's out/; parallel jobs may contend on shared user cache dirs despite separate WorkDir packs.
findings.fix_hint: Set a per-job HOME/XDG_* under JobDir and kill the Blender process group on ctx cancel (SysProcAttr.Setpgid + negative PID signal).

findings.bug: Gate evidence for SHOT-02 concurrent isolation uses separate Parents (`parent/<shot>`) and only checks outs[0]==outs[1] || outs[1]==outs[2], omitting outs[0] vs outs[2]; does not exercise same-parent MkdirTemp like TestConcurrentJobsIsolated.
findings.predicted: Regressions in same-`--out` concurrent shot preview uniqueness or incomplete pairwise job-dir checks can green while colliding.
findings.fix_hint: Run all three shots with the same Parent, assert pairwise distinct JobDir/PNG/manifest paths, and mirror that matrix for compile once nesting is fixed.
